title: Backward-Direction Onion-Encryption Security
summary: The forward direction has a security model and proof, while the corresponding backward-direction treatment remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Extend the onion-encryption security model and CGO security proof from the forward direction to the backward direction.

scope.domain: Structural security analysis of onion encryption and the Counter Galois Onion (CGO) construction.
parameters: the forward and backward directions of onion encryption, distinguishing the existing and unresolved security cases
scope.unresolved_remainder: Extend the onion-encryption security model and CGO security proof from the forward direction to the backward direction.

citations.label: Secure Onion Encryption and the Case of Counter Galois Onion

progress.summary: The source presents this as future work: it models and proves security for the forward direction, while leaving a similar treatment of the backward direction unresolved.
citation_labels: Jean Paul Degabriele et al., Secure Onion Encryption and the Case of Counter Galois Onion
